title: Silver zeolite methanol dehydrogenation experiments
publisher: Zenodo; originating researchers: Palkovits, Regina; Simitsis, Natalia (RWTH Aachen University); Mebrahtu, Chalachew (RWTH Aachen University); Müller, Felix (RWTH Aachen University); Zobel, Mirijam (Forschungszentrum Jülich)
deterministic_selection_rule: Complete source record unless otherwise specified.

measurement_dates.description: Instrument headers include 2023 measurements (for example physisorption on 2023-02-17); complete campaign dates not asserted. Released 2025-06-18; deposited 2025-06-20.
measurement_dates.status: documented where explicit; otherwise unknown, never inferred from release

author_preprocessing: Source characterization includes instrument reductions, baseline-corrected products and figure-oriented catalytic tables alongside some raw exports. Instrument headers preserve original units and sample identifiers.
known_analyses_and_limitations: DOI 10.1039/d5cy00544b already reports Ag/Hbeta-catalyzed methanol dehydrogenation. Multiple characterizations of one catalyst are not independent catalysts. A broad claim needs additional synthesis batches; original 7z is retained without a duplicate extracted tree.
